message: 波乱のバースデー

name: Macaron
message: 「Th-This wasn't supposed to happen...」

name: Synn
message: 「Looks like everyone went pretty all-out」

name: Macaron
message: 「Ughhh...」

name: Pasta
message: 「Unyaa! This isn't what we agreed on, nya! We got totally beat up, nya!」

name: Sally
message: 「Well, they say luck's a big part of any match. Guess you just had bad luck」

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Eauderourke, hungry」

name: Macaron
message: 「W-Well, that's impressive, I guess. I'll admit that I lost」

name: Synn
message: 「You didn't get hurt or anything?」

name: Macaron
message: 「I'm fine. Not a scratch」

name: Synn
message: 「I see, thank goodness」

name: Macaron
message: 「Yeah...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Auh... Still, like this, I can't say it...」

name: Macaron
message: 「I don't know how else I'm supposed to be honest with my feelings...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Big brother, you dummy...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Have you finally gotten it out of your system too, Mako-chan?」

name: Macaron
message: 「G-Gotten it out of my system, that's not the issue at all!」

name: Misa
message: 「Indeed. In a contest, there are times when one simply cannot afford to compromise」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Why don't you just defect to the Warusaders already, Madam Vice President?」

name: Ria
message: 「Oh, that actually sounds kind of fun」

name: Misa
message: 「Dear Sister!? How cruel of you!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Aaand now that our business is done, we're heading home, Synn」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, sorry about this. Right when you're about to have a study session...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ahh, well, yeah, there's that too, I guess...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's right! In fact, we have prepared a special surprise just for you, President!」

name: Synn
message: 「Shpeshul?」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun. Do you remember what day today is?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Come on, seriously?!」

name: Macaron
message: 「......Isn't today your birthday? Big brother's birthday」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「How is Mako-chan remembering it better than you?」

name: Synn
message: 「Man, I completely forgot about that」

name: Ria
message: 「Actually, we've been preparing a birthday party for you in secret, Synn-kun」

name: Lolotte
message: 「We have prepared wonderful presents as well♪」

name: Misa
message: 「I-It's strictly just on the side of our study session, okay!」

name: Synn
message: 「E-Everyone...... thank you!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Oh, I get it......」

name: Macaron
message: 「That's why Nana-oneechan was asking big brother all those questions the other day!」

name: Synn
message: 「She was?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ta-hahahaha! Whatever could you mean!?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Uh, but」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Never mind that! Come to Synn's birthday party too, Mako-chan! It'll be fun!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Festivities are always more fun with a big crowd!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Big brother, would you be happy if I came?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah」

name: Macaron
message: 「Au...... o-okay」

name: Macaron
message: 「As a special treat today, I'll celebrate for you, Big Brother!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yay」

name: Macaron
message: 「Well, that was the plan from the start, though...」

name: Melphas
message: 「A birthday party to celebrate you, our President, is it」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ugya!? Who are you?」

name: Melphas
message: 「If it is to be a banquet where such lovely maidens gather, I simply cannot refrain from participating myself」

name: Misa
message: 「Kyaah!? Perverts will be handed over to the police!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Well then, shall everyone go to Big Brother's house and celebrate too」

name: Sally
message: 「Yay~! There's gonna be a feast for sure~♪」

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Eaude, feast, wanna eat!」

name: Pasta
message: 「Nyanu!? Pasta is being dragged along too, nya?」

name: Macaron
message: 「It's an order from the Demon Lord」

name: Pasta
message: 「Nyauu... It can't be helped, nya...」

name: Macaron
message: 「It's fine. Parties at Big Brother's place are fun. I guarantee it」

name: Synn
message: 「Sniff, thanks everyone...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's still too early to be crying」

name: Macaron
message: 「Come on, let's go」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah」

name: Pasta
message: 「Nyafufu. Inviting an enemy into his own home, what a fool he is, nya」

name: Paqy
message: 「Not like there's anything worth stealing anyway」

name: Pasta
message: 「I-Is that so, nya?」

name: Sally
message: 「Boss, be careful~」

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Eaude, cramped...」

name: Synn
message: 「It might not look like it, but the framing is sturdy, so it'll be fine」

name: Ria
message: 「To tell you the truth, preparations are actually still underway...」

name: Macaron
message: 「I'll help out!」

name: Synn
message: 「Then I will too」

name: Sally
message: 「Prez is the guest of honor, so you just gotta hang out with me」

name: Melphas
message: 「In that case, allow me to volunteer as cooking instructor in his stead」

name: Synn
message: 「Shall we get going, Melphas-san?」

name: Melphas
message: 「Oh my, being popular certainly has its hardships」

name: Paqy
message: 「The great me wants Ria-chan to do the cooking!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hup」

name: Paqy
message: 「Gyaaaah!? My insides are gonna pop out!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huuuuuh~...」

name: Synn
message: 「Fwooooaaah!」

name: Ria
message: 「Alright everyone, on three」

name: Everyone
message: 「Happy birthday!」

name: Synn
message: 「Thank you so much!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Now then, without further ado, here comes the cake cutting~\s07」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ria-chan's nipples!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh my, what a delicious-looking panda」

name: Paqy
message: 「Jaspyon!」

name: Sally
message: 「Can we eat already? We can, right? Not listening to your answer~♪」

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Feast, yummy!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Come on, come on, you eat too, Onii-chan」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-yeah...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Jeez, I went out of my way to celebrate for you, so look a little happier already」

name: Synn
message: 「Uhyawa~i! I can't help dancing for joy!」

name: Macaron
message: 「That's bad manners, so sit down」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes ma'am......」

name: Pasta
message: 「......Macaron, you've completely gotten used to the humans, nya」

name: Macaron
message: 「You think so? Just look at Melphas and the others」

name: Melphas
message: 「Your name is Lolotte-san, you say? You are as lovely as an angel.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Why, thank you!」

name: Misa
message: 「Hey, you over there! Get any closer and that's a crime!」

name: Pasta
message: 「......Well, that guy's out of his mind, nya」

name: Macaron
message: 「Come on, Pasta-chan, let's enjoy ourselves together?」

name: Pasta
message: 「I don't have the slightest intention of celebrating the Student Council President, nya」

name: Macaron
message: 「But we're all allies and friends, aren't we?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Getting along like this, there's no way it wouldn't be fun」

name: Pasta
message: 「......What a carefree one, nya」

name: Pasta
message: 「Still, I'll at least help myself to filling my stomach, nya」

name: Macaron
message: 「Go right ahead, go right ahead. Nihehe」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, so good! Both the cake and the beefsteak are delicious! So delicious!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Aren't you exaggerating~」

name: Synn
message: 「Getting celebrated by so many people like this, I really am a lucky guy」

name: Macaron
message: 「That means you're gonna pay us back plenty on everyone's birthdays, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, sounds great!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Should we look forward to it, Nana-oneechan?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You bet!」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I'll do my best...」

name: Ria
message: 「Well then, Synn-kun, see you later~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Congratulations again on today! Goodbye now!」

name: Misa
message: 「Don't forget to study for your tests, either」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, thanks so much for everything」

name: Nanaka
message: 「See ya! Synn, Mako-chan, goodnight!」

name: Synn
message: 「Goodnight~」

name: Macaron
message: 「Bye-bye」

name: Synn
message: 「...Huh, Melphas-san and Pasta aren't here either」

name: Sally
message: 「If you're looking for the Boss and the others, they headed back a little while ago」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, I see」

name: Sally
message: 「I'm full and sleepy too, so I'm gonna turn in. Goodnight~」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, goodnight」
Somehow, today felt even more hectic than usual.
Even so, I feel like it was all the more fulfilling because of it.
That's surely because Macaron was right by my side...

name: Macaron
message: 「Big Brother」

name: Synn
message: 「What is it?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Let's hurry up and go inside. It's cold!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, yeah, you're right」

name: Macaron
message: 「Hey... do you have a second?」

name: Synn
message: 「What's wrong?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Come to my room for just a little bit right now」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? Sure...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Wait just a second」
Macaron slips inside the tent and rummages around for something.

name: Macaron
message: 「Ta-da! A Blackuma belly warmer~♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa! What's this?!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Here you go, big brother. A birthday present」

name: Synn
message: 「Can I really have it?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Well, if you don't want it, I won't give it to you」

name: Synn
message: 「I want it, I want it! I'll gladly take it!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Hehehe, I knitted it myself. It's super warm, you know」

name: Synn
message: 「I bet it is」
It must be packed full of Macaron's warm heart!

name: Synn
message: 「All right, right away!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Kyaaah?!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Hey, dummy! Don't take your clothes off here, you pervert!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, sorry, sorry. I just got so happy I couldn't help it」

name: Macaron
message: 「Honestly, jeez...」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, I see」

name: Synn
message: 「You were hiding in your room the other day because of this, weren't you」

name: Macaron
message: 「Huh? W-Well, yeah, I guess! Pretty sharp for you, big bro」

name: Synn
message: 「Could it be that it matches yours, Macaron...」

name: Macaron
message: 「As if!」

name: Macaron
message: 「I wouldn't wear something as uncool as a belly warmer!」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, right」

name: Macaron
message: 「It might match Master's, though...」

name: Synn
message: 「Well anyway, I'll take good care of it」

name: Macaron
message: 「You better!」

name: Macaron
message: 「And I'm really looking forward to my birthday!」

name: Synn
message: 「O-oh, yeah. I'll do my best」

name: Macaron
message: 「Hehehe. Yay♪」
Just having Macaron's smile around mysteriously warms my heart.
That alone makes me feel so fulfilled...
Of course, the belly warmer keeps my stomach warm too.
